sentences.en: A fund was set up to preserve endangered marine life.
sentences.zh: 为了保护濒危海洋生物，建立了一个基金。

sentences.en: Dolphins and whales are not fish, but rather marine mammals.
sentences.zh: 海豚和鲸鱼不是鱼类，而是海洋哺乳动物。

sentences.en: Marine species are moving to new locations toward cooler waters.
sentences.zh: 海洋物种正在向较凉爽的水域的新地点迁移。
